facts.text: Gwanaksan Mountain dominates the skyline of Gwanak-gu, rising to 1,030 meters and offering panoramic views of Seoul.
Gwanak-gu houses Seoul National University, Korea’s oldest and most prestigious university, whose campus buzzes with youthful energy.
Nakseongdae Park sits atop Gwanak Mountain and hosts the annual Nakseongdae Indeungje memorial ceremony honoring the famed Joseon scholar.
Gwanaksan Ecological Park provides a green escape where hikers can explore trails that weave through ancient pine forests and limestone cliffs.
The former Belgian Consulate Office in Gwanak-gu now serves as a cultural venue, preserving early 20th‑century architecture.
Gwanak Road (Gwanak-ro) and Sillim Road form the main artery for commuters, linking the district to Seoul’s central business district.
